notes: All measured before/after startup and warmed outputs are bit-identical within each backend. Window workload native/Wasm outputs are also bit-identical.
Other 21 native kernel probes and all eight examples have byte-identical objects; their timing variation is not attributed to this change.
f32 window object growth is 1280 bytes; f64 growth is 224 bytes. LLVM chooses vectorization and unrolling.
Simple offset views already recovered alignment after inlining; native gains here come from proving independence between same-object regions.
Initial pilot runs are excluded. One pilot required tolerance for existing sine-initialized native/Wasm parity; final window workloads use exactly representable fractions.
